Preconditions: Approved isolated bench; nominal devices; crossing clear
Test_steps: Request crossing; observe green-to-amber-to-all-red; complete WALK and clearance
Expected_result: Both vehicle directions confirmed STOP before WALK; pedestrian clears before any vehicle release
Evidence_required: Input capture; state timeline; electrical read-back; audit chain
Pass_rule: No conflicting release and timing within approved limits
Stop_condition: WALK with either conflicting vehicle not STOP

Hazard_or_question: Child group exposed or school rules bypassed
Preconditions: School profile; approved timing; occupancy sensors
Test_steps: Create child demand; add school-zone vehicle; run and repeat
Expected_result: Conservative school sequence; STOP-before-WALK; protected clearance; deterministic repeat
Evidence_required: Sensor capture; video of load bank; decision and event records
Pass_rule: Expected state and repeat hash/decision equivalence
Stop_condition: Any conflicting release or premature recovery

Preconditions: Violation catalogue mapped to physical/emulated inputs

Evidence_required: Per-case input/output capture; test run IDs; audit records
Pass_rule: All catalogue cases meet approved expected results

Preconditions: Queue threshold calibrated; stored pedestrian demand

Expected_result: Demand retained and served within approved maximum; both directions STOP for WALK
Evidence_required: Queue frames; timer trace; decision log; electrical feedback
Stop_condition: Demand loss; wait limit breach; conflicting movement

Hazard_or_question: Emergency request conflicts with pedestrian safety
Preconditions: Authenticated emergency simulator; approved direction mapping
Test_steps: Request emergency before demand; during clearance; with unauthenticated request; opposing requests
Expected_result: Authenticated single route only when safe; pedestrian in crossing retains clearance; invalid/opposing request holds safely
Evidence_required: Identity/auth logs; input frames; state/read-back timeline
Pass_rule: All priority and rejection rules match specification
Stop_condition: Emergency passage during occupied crossing or unauthenticated release

Pass_rule: No release based on optimistic source

Hazard_or_question: Silence inferred as safe or previous command persists
Test_steps: Drop sensor link; controller link; audit link separately and together
Expected_result: No new release; approved fail-safe/hold; loss alarm; reconciliation before recovery
Evidence_required: Network capture; watchdog state; electrical read-back; audit/alarm
Pass_rule: Safe state for every partition and verified recovery
Stop_condition: Unknown output or automatic unsafe resume

Expected_result: Outputs restore in approved safe state; no WALK/GREEN until identity/time/state reconciliation
Evidence_required: Power trace; boot logs; controller read-back; recovery audit

Hazard_or_question: Override defeats safety invariant or lacks accountability

Test_steps: Attempt unauthorised override; authorised safe-hold; attempted unsafe release; expiry
Expected_result: Unauthorised/unsafe action rejected; safe-hold accepted; actor/action/expiry logged
Evidence_required: Access logs; audit chain; UI/controller state
Pass_rule: No override can cause WALK conflict; complete attribution

Preconditions: All relevant simulators connected; priority specification approved

Evidence_required: All input captures; single decision; rejected alternatives; electrical read-back; repeat records

Expected_result: Invalid time quarantined; safe hold; recovery after bounded synchronisation and reconciliation

Hazard_or_question: Decision cannot be reconstructed or record altered
Preconditions: Append-only store; backup target; access roles
Test_steps: Write run; attempt mutation/deletion; fill near capacity; backup and restore
Expected_result: Mutation/access denied or detected; capacity alarm; restored chain verifies
Evidence_required: Storage audit; hashes; access denial; restore report

Evidence_required: Before/after manifests; isolation proof; regression and restore reports
Pass_rule: All rollback steps and verification pass
